note.note:
I’m ready to generate the Problem List Clinical Note, but I need the consult materials first.

Please provide:
1) The raw transcript of the consult (doctor–patient conversation).  
2) The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON output.

Notes on preferred formats:
- Transcript: plain text of the full conversation (include clinician and patient lines).  
- DDx: JSON or plain text list of differential diagnoses and associated likelihoods/reasoning.

I will treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx only if consistent with the transcript.
